propositions: Bridge operators lack an on-demand, non-blocking way to verify that mapped project keys and legacy_default are visible to the bot outside a full reconcile pass
The bridge fsck command must add an opt-in --live-visibility flag that performs a read-only live visibility check against Jira for mapped keys and legacy_default
When JIRA credentials (JIRA_URL, JIRA_USER, JIRA_API_TOKEN) are absent or incomplete, the visibility check must gracefully skip with a 'missing_credentials' advisory rather than fail
The visibility check must reuse the shared helper from ticket D (check_mapped_project_visibility) to avoid duplicate existence-check logic
The live visibility advisory output must go to stderr and must not alter the default bridge fsck exit contract or the stdout JSON schema
Core rebar doctor command must remain Jira-free with no reconciler or agents imports reachable from doctor.py
